title: Serve preflight executor
description: Runs before `nx serve <app>` (the composer depends on it, with the serve's own flags forwarded). Nx runs ONE `<app>:dev-stack` per workspace and makes a second invocation WAIT on the first — and end with it, without having served what it asked for. When this workspace's Nx already serves the app, this names the running stack (offset, pid, URL, owner) and either refuses a request for a different stack (--port-offset / --worktree), printing the `tools/dev/dev serve` command that starts it beside the running one, or says that this run attaches to the running stack (what an e2e target depending on `dev-stack` wants).

project.description: The served app. Defaults to the project this target is attached to.

portOffset.description: Forwarded from `nx serve` — the stack the run asks for.

worktree.description: Forwarded from `nx serve` — the tree the run asks for.
